description: Source code for a keyword set search implementation, including trie-based algorithms and string matching functions, used in GNU grep for pattern matching.

methods.name: obstack_chunk_alloc
methods.description: Allocates memory chunks for obstack, with a check for negative sizes.

methods.name: kwsalloc
methods.description: Allocates and initializes a keyword set object.

methods.name: kwsincr
methods.description: Adds a string to the keyword set, building a trie of reversed keywords.

methods.name: kwsprep
methods.description: Prepares the keyword set for search, computing delta tables and failure functions.

methods.name: kwsexec
methods.description: Performs pattern matching on input text using the keyword set.

methods.name: kwsfree
methods.description: Frees resources associated with the keyword set.
